candidates.change_summary: Change owner() to return a constant zero address instead of _owner
Change owner() to return msg.sender instead of _owner
Remove the require check that prevents transferring ownership to the zero address.
Replace ownership transfer with a call to transfer to a hardcoded external address instead of newOwner, altering the resulting owner.
Replace _transferOwnership(newOwner) with _transferOwnership(msg.sender), so ownership is transferred to the caller instead of the argument.
Change the onlyOwner modifier to require the caller to be the zero address, effectively blocking all onlyOwner functions including transferOwnership.
Delete the assignment to rewardDistributor so the state variable is never updated.
Assign address(0) instead of the provided _distributor address.
Assign msg.sender instead of the provided _distributor address.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier to allow anyone to change rewardDistributor.
Remove the require statement so onlyOwner performs no check, allowing anyone to call owner-restricted functions.
